title: Expose independently sourced status freshness for linked Investigate Cases in selected Incident
goal: Complete CAP-CMD-106/CAP-CMD-101 Class-0 linked Case status display with Investigate-owner observation time, source/version and freshness so a stale or unknown Case status cannot be presented as current.
invariants: Incident remains Command-owned; linked Case and its status/freshness stay Investigate-owned; linking source never asserts status freshness.
No invented recency threshold, policy or source time: absent status freshness and observation remain explicitly unknown.
Only selected authorized Incident and independently link+Case-readable records; no new navigation/mutation/provider/IAM or changes to audited PR #178.
security_properties: Read-only source fields arrive solely from independently authorized Investigate Case identity owner; unselected/Task/denied request triggers no link/source read.
Validated source, UTF-8, RFC3339Nano timestamp and constrained freshness before any selected HTTP/HTML response; positive freshness state without source+date fails closed.
Invalid or cancelled source after a previous valid linked Case yields generic 503 without partial Case/Incident metadata; denied Case metadata never included.

migration.rationale: Additive optional source-owned status metadata on existing selected linked Case JSON and existing Go autoescaped HTML; legacy nil metadata stays unknown.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional Case status source/freshness fields and HTML text to restore frozen PR #178 projections.
verification: Existing linked_cases_join_test.go and linked_cases_test.go remain green

inputs: Full canonical CAP-CMD-106 §§9,15-19,22 and CAP-CMD-101 §§15-17 with status stale/source/date; owner separation and OPEN-013.
Frozen PR #178 SHA f4ac42195fed1286837f5ff2b2818878c7fad28f; exact-head Go and engineering CI success, draft/L2 not merged.
outputs: Selected authorized Incident Case summaries include only independently sourced Investigate status source, optional version, observation timestamp and freshness via unchanged first-party HTTP/HTML.
Behavioral Go tests with 2 authorized Cases + 1 denied; current/stale/unknown and malformed source/time => no data leak.
acceptance_tests: On selected authorized Incident, link relation carries only link source/version; Investigate source supplies observed UTC timestamp, status freshness/source and optional source version, shown both in JSON and escaped HTML.
Absent Investigate status freshness/source timestamp explicitly unknown with no invented current-time claim; no Case/Incident mutation or new route.
Missing observation/source with claimed current/stale/partial, invalid RFC3339 timestamp/status source, unauthorized/denied records fail closed and no partial data is returned.
Exact-head Linux/macOS/Windows runtime Go + mandatory engineering-kernel security checks pass unchanged.

performance_budget.rationale: Reuses existing at most 16 sequential authorized Case source reads; only bounded optional metadata validation/rendering per source, no extra network call or scan.
metrics: One Shared lookup, <=16 Investigate lookups for selected authorized Incident only
No extra HTTP route, owner re-read, background scan or timer

definition_of_ready: E10-CMD-106B-SOURCEJOIN is IMPLEMENTED on frozen PR #178; exact-head Go/engineering Actions green, L2 task already executed (report unknown), no production adapter.
CAP-CMD-106 §15 source/date stale state and CAP-CMD-101 §15 stale disclosure remain absent and can progress Class-0 without OPEN-013 Class-2 mutations.
definition_of_done: Published first-party status freshness projection source+time/unknown semantics, security tests and exact-head GitHub CI evidence, no mandatory gate bypass.
Independent read-only material L2 after stable SHA; non-merged draft is NOT production or CAP-CMD-106 acceptance.
